description: Many forms need a list of things rather than a single answer: the people in a household, emergency contacts, previous jobs, the attendees you are registering for an event. On a Power Pages form this normally means building a child table, a subgrid, table permissions and sign-in. Repeating Group Editor gives you the whole repeating section inside one text column: people add as many entries as they need, each entry has its own fields, and everything is checked while they type.
features: Different fields and an orange accent
